display.purpose: One greeting or title per view, Berkshire Swash.

shadows.name: tab-lift
shadows.purpose: Category tabs casting upward onto the wood.

shadows.name: plank
shadows.purpose: Large panels such as the order area.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Brass Doubloon main action, such as Place Order.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(#aa8139, #84642b); color: #000; font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; padding: 10px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; box-shadow: 0 8px 16px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.2); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Rum Red exit or destructive action, such as Log Out.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: linear-gradient(#ad2535, #8e1f2c); color: #000; font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; padding: 10px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; box-shadow: 0 8px 16px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.2); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Landing Button
components.description: Dark green landing-page call to action.
components.css: .ds-btn-landing { background: linear-gradient(#254540, #0c2924); color: #fff; font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; padding: 10px 32px; border: thin solid #000; border-radius: 7px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 10px black, -2px -2px 10px black; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-landing:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Category Tabs
components.description: Drink category tabs; active joins the panel below.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-tab { background: #567973; color: #000; font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; padding: 3px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0; box-shadow: 2px -2px 10px black, 2px 0 10px black; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-active { background: #a4b9b6; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Drink Card
components.description: Pale sea-glass card with bottle, name and price.
components.css: .ds-drink { background: #c0cfcc; color: #000; font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 6px; width: 160px; }

components.name: Order Panel
components.description: Deep Kelp checkout panel with Seafoam heading and total.
components.css: .ds-order { background: #254540; color: #96b9a5; font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; padding: 16px; width: 220px; box-shadow: 5px 5px 30px black; } .ds-order h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 1.5rem; text-align: center; }

narrative.overview: A warm wooden bar on a pirate ship. Dark wood planks cover the background of the working views. Sea-glass green panels sit on top like frosted portholes, with brass and rum-red fittings for the actions that matter. The storm and the white ship logo belong to the landing page only: the storm stays outside, and inside the tavern it is cosy and hospitable. The working views are tools first; the theme lives in materials, in the swash display font, and in the Pirate language option.
keyCharacteristics: Dark wood texture under every working view; storm photo on the landing page.
Cool sea-glass greens for surfaces, warm brass and rum red for actions.
Berkshire Swash for greetings and titles, Oswald for everything else.
Heavy black shadows that make panels look carved and raised.

rules.name: The Two Metals Rule
rules.body: Warm colour means action. Brass is for the primary action and Rum Red for leaving or destroying. Surfaces never use either metal.

rules.name: The One Swash Rule
rules.body: Berkshire Swash appears once per view, for the greeting or title. Everything a user must read quickly is Oswald.

rules.name: The Carved Wood Rule
rules.body: Every surface on the wood background has a shadow. A panel without one looks pasted on.

dos: Do keep the wood texture under working views and the storm on the landing page only.
Do use Brass Doubloon for the single primary action in a view and Rum Red for exit or destructive actions.
Do set panel headings in Seafoam on Deep Kelp, and body text in Ink on sea-glass surfaces.
Do give every raised surface on the wood a black shadow from the vocabulary above.
donts: Don't use brass or red for surfaces or decoration; they mean action.
Don't use Berkshire Swash for prices, lists, labels or buttons.
Don't put Ink text directly on the wood or storm backgrounds; use Sail White there.
Don't add new one-off greens. Pick from the six sea-glass neutrals.
